subject: Request: minute-level quota uplift + escrowed true-up (BrightLaunch)
messages:
From: Kaito Suzuki <kaito@lumen.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Park <emma@lumen.co>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLaunch week — temporary uplift request

Hi Priyom,

We have a hard launch for BrightLaunch scheduled for next Tuesday (7/22). Traffic tests this morning show a tighter latency profile and we expect minute-level spikes that will exceed our current quota by ~3–4x during two 30-minute windows.

Can Redwood accommodate a short-lived concurrency/throughput uplift for that launch window? The engineering team needs an answer today so we can finish the runbook. We attached our traffic plan and estimated token curves.

Two asks from our side:
- Temporary throughput bump (minute-level throttle increase) for 7/22 14:00–14:30 PT and 7/22 18:00–18:30 PT
- An invoice/true-up approach that lets us ship without committing to a long-term tier immediately (we can do escrowed payment/PO if helpful)

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Kaito
Senior Platform Engineer
Lumen Labs

Attachments: BrightLaunch-traffic-plan.pdf (pdf, 220KB)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Kaito Suzuki <kaito@lumen.co>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLaunch week — temporary uplift request

Hi Kaito — thanks for the plan and the heads up.

Short answer: yes, we can.

High-level proposal (can finalize after we confirm numbers):
1) Short window uplift: we can provision minute-level headroom for the two windows you specified. We'll route requests through an elevated concurrency lane with a soft cap and a rapid fallback if sustained beyond 30 minutes.
2) Escrowed true-up: we propose an escrow invoice for the estimated uplift (you can treat this as a provisional PO). If actual consumption is lower, we credit the difference; if higher, we'll true-up at the overrun rate described below.
3) Overrun rate and caps: uplift billing will use a temporary overrun multiplier of 1.25x the listed per-token rate for burst capacity, capped at a pre-agreed upper limit. Any sustained usage beyond the two windows would revert to your normal committed tiers.

Required next steps from Lumen: confirm the exact per-window peak QPS (or token rate) and provide the signed provisional PO/escrow instruction (procurement@lumen.co). From our side we'll queue the configuration and validate end-to-end with your test host.

Looping in Hannah (commercial) and Laura (ops) to finalize the SLA/true-up paperwork and get legal/PO language prepared. I'm also attaching a brief term sheet that outlines escrow mechanics.

If you confirm numbers by 12:00 PT we can commit to having the lane ready and smoke-tested by 7/21 EOD.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai

Attachments: provisional-escrow-term-sheet.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
From: Emma Park <emma@lumen.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Kaito Suzuki <kaito@lumen.co>
Cc: procurement@lumen.co
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLaunch week — temporary uplift request

Thanks Priyom — this looks reasonable. Quick procurement note: we need a short PO (two-line) and a statement of work/invoiceable term so our finance team can place funds into escrow. Can Redwood accept a PO that references an escrowed hold and then invoices after consumption reconciliation?

Also confirming the peak estimates: team expects 3000–3500 reqs/min (~2.1M tokens over both windows). We can round up if that simplifies provisioning.

Procurement contact (for Redwood legal/finance): procurement@lumen.co

Emma Park
Business Operations, Lumen Labs
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Park <emma@lumen.co>, procurement@lumen.co
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLaunch week — temporary uplift request

Emma / procurement team — thanks for the numbers and clarity.

Confirming Redwood's commercial path:
- We will accept a two-line PO referencing the provisional escrow. Redwood Finance will place the funds into an internal escrow account once the PO and remittance instructions are validated.
- Reconciliation: final invoice will compare actual uplift consumption to the escrowed amount; underconsumption will be credited to your account or refunded per your preference, overconsumption will be invoiced at the agreed overrun multiplier (1.25x).
- Rate ceiling: to keep costs predictable we propose an absolute ceiling of $18,000 for the uplift windows unless you authorize otherwise in writing.
- Operational readiness: Laura will schedule a 30-min smoke test on 7/21 10:00–10:30 PT to validate routing and fallback behavior.

Please confirm acceptance and attach the PO (PDF). Once we have the PO we will kick the configuration and send the DocuSign envelope for the escrow/true-up terms.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai

---
